name: Circles: radius, diameter, and touching circles
definition: A circle is every point the same distance from the centre, so the radius is the fact everything else is built on. When circles touch, the distance between their centres is the sum of the radii - drawing that line is usually the move.
recognizeWhen: the radius of the small circle is
the circle fits exactly inside the square
find the distance between the two centres
misconceptions: I used the radius where the problem gave me the diameter.
I forgot to draw the line joining the two centres.
I assumed a circle inside a square touches the corners rather than the sides.
